We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case: forklift operation without certification, causing death due to wood veneer falling, victim died. The operator (owner) didn't have forklift license. This is a traffic/industrial accident. The relevant charge list includes "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) and "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent endangerment using dangerous method). Also "重大责任事故" maybe for major responsibility accident. In examples, similar case: earlier example about fire caused by welding had charge "失火". For forklift accident causing death, earlier example: "付肖某...因疏忽大意，将骑电动车经过的被害人马某撞倒碾压，致使马某当场死亡。" The answer was "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". Wait that example had two charges: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". The facts: driver of excavator (铲车) collided with motorbike, causing death. They gave both charges: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". So they considered both negligent homicide and damage to production/operation? The case: "付肖某在滑县新区宣武新村工地驾驶铲车装土...因疏忽大意，将骑电动车经过的被害人马某撞倒碾压，致使马某当场死亡。" The answer: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". So they added "破坏生产经营" maybe because the act disrupted production? Not sure.

Our case: forklift operation without license, wood veneer fell, killed worker. Could be "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method). The list includes that. In similar case of dangerous method causing death? Example: "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" appears in list but not used in examples. The forklift is a dangerous equipment; operating without license is negligence. The death is due to accident. The appropriate charge likely "过失致人死亡". Possibly also "重大责任事故" if qualifies as major responsibility accident (industrial accident). The list includes "重大责任事故". Example earlier: "重大责任事故" used for mine accident with many deaths. That is for major accidents causing death and large loss. Here only one death, but still could be considered major responsibility accident? Not sure.

The example with forklift accident gave "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". So we may follow that pattern: include "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "破坏生产经营". The forklift accident occurred at a factory, causing death, maybe also considered "破坏生产经营" (damage to production). The wood veneer fell, causing death, but also damage? Not mentioned. The wood fell onto worker, not necessarily damage to production. The list includes "破坏生产经营" as a charge for causing damage to production. The earlier example used it because the accident disrupted production? The fact: "付肖某...在工地...因疏忽大意，将骑电动车经过的被害人马某撞倒碾压". That is not necessarily production damage. Yet they added "破坏生产经营". Possibly they consider any accident at a construction site as "破坏生产经营". So we might include both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营<eoa>
